definitions.explanation: Marks the ending point in time. {五時|ごじ}まで{働|はたら}く (work until 5 o'clock), {明日|あした}まで (until tomorrow).
Marks the ending point in space. {駅|えき}まで{歩|ある}く (walk to the station).
Emphasizes an extreme or unexpected extent. {彼|かれ}まで{来|き}た (even he came), {子供|こども}まで{知|し}っている (even children know).
Indicates the degree to which something extends. {泣|な}くまで{笑|わら}った (laughed until [I] cried).

particle_contrasts.explanation: まで emphasizes extent/continuation to endpoint; に marks a specific point

examples.made_note: まで emphasizes duration up to endpoint

examples.ni_note: に marks a specific point in time

key_points: まで = extent/duration up to a point
までに = 'by' (deadline): {五時|ごじ}までに (by 5 o'clock)

particle_contrasts.explanation: Both can mean 'even,' but まで emphasizes extent while も indicates inclusion

examples.made_example: {子供|こども}まで{知|し}っている

examples.mo_example: {子供|こども}も{知|し}っている

key_points: まで implies going as far as an unexpected point

fixed_patterns.example: {東京|とうきょう}から{大阪|おおさか}まで
{金曜日|きんようび}までに{終|お}わらせる
{来週|らいしゅう}まで{会|あ}えない
{分|わ}かるまで{説明|せつめい}する
{今|いま}まで{知|し}らなかった
どこまでも{続|つづ}く{道|みち}
fixed_patterns.example_english: a road that goes on forever

examples.japanese: {十二時|じゅうにじ}まで{起|お}きていました。
{東京|とうきょう}から{大阪|おおさか}まで{新幹線|しんかんせん}で{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I'll take the Shinkansen from Tokyo to Osaka.
examples.notes: から...まで for spatial range

examples.japanese: ここまで{来|き}てくれてありがとう。
examples.english: Thank you for coming all the way here.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}まで{分|わ}かる{簡単|かんたん}な{問題|もんだい}です。
examples.english: It's such an easy problem that even children understand.

examples.japanese: {金曜日|きんようび}までに{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。

common_mistakes.mistake: Confusing まで with までに
common_mistakes.context: {五時|ごじ}まで vs {五時|ごじ}までに
common_mistakes.explanation: まで = until 5 (continuous); までに = by 5 (deadline)

common_mistakes.mistake: Using まで when に is more appropriate
common_mistakes.incorrect: {三時|さんじ}まで{始|はじ}まる
common_mistakes.explanation: Use に for specific point events; まで for duration/extent

common_mistakes.mistake: Using も instead of まで for 'even' (surprising extent)
common_mistakes.context: When emphasizing an unexpected extreme, まで is stronger
common_mistakes.explanation: {先生|せんせい}まで{間違|まちが}えた (even the teacher made a mistake) vs {先生|せんせい}も{間違|まちが}えた (the teacher also made a mistake)

notes: まで often pairs with から: {九時|くじ}から{五時|ごじ}まで (from 9 to 5). Unlike に (which marks a specific point), まで emphasizes the extent or continuation up to that point. までに means 'by (a deadline)': {金曜日|きんようび}までに (by Friday). As 'even,' まで is stronger than も, implying a surprising extreme.
